cases.name: LightGBM binary classification with temporal split
cases.input: Write the training loop for a LightGBM binary classification model on a time-series dataset.
expected_behaviors: Uses only training-time features (not inference-only features) for model training
Applies temporal train/val/test split: e.g. train_end = max_date - 365d, val_end = max_date - 90d
Uses temporal cross-validation (time-ordered folds), not random k-fold
Logs avg_average_precision and roc_auc per fold to MLflow
Sets the binary classification objective (binary or cross_entropy)
should_not: Use inference-only features (unavailable for new records at training time) in training
Use random k-fold cross-validation on temporal data
Use sklearn's KFold or StratifiedKFold without accounting for time ordering

cases.name: Quantile regression with log transform
cases.input: Set up a LightGBM model for a regression target with a right-skewed distribution.
expected_behaviors: Applies log1p transform to the target before training
Uses quantile regression objective with alpha=0.5 (median regression) for skewed targets
Applies expm1 inverse transform to predictions before evaluation
Evaluates on original scale (MAE, R²) not on log scale
should_not: Use MSE/RMSE objective instead of quantile alpha=0.5 for skewed targets

cases.name: MultiOutputRegressor feature importance
cases.input: Extract feature importances from a MultiOutputRegressor model.
expected_behaviors: Accesses feature importances via model.estimators_[i].feature_importances_ for each target
Explains that MultiOutputRegressor wraps individual estimators and has no top-level feature_importances_ attribute
Shows how to average importances across all target estimators
Lists the target names to clarify which estimator index corresponds to which target
should_not: Assume a single estimator covers all targets
